Name: Timed Life
Description: Phase: Any Phase Type: Passive Remove this Unit at the End of the Round.

Name: Overwatch
Description: Phase: Assault Phase Type: Reaction Cost: 0 CP Use when an Enemy Unit ends its Activation Within 8" of this Unit. This Unit immediately performs a Ranged Attack against that Enemy Unit.

Name: Target Lock
Description: Phase: Movement Phase Type: Active Cost: 1 CP Select one Enemy Unit Within 12". Whenever a Friendly Goliath Unit targets that enemy with an Autocannon, that weapon gains Surge Type: Light, Armoured, and S Dice: D3+1.

Name: <color=#2596be>Ares-Class Targeting System</color>
Description: Phase: Any Phase Type: Passive Upgrade ability This Unit's Autocannon and Underbelly Machine Gun weapons gain PRECISION (1).

Name: Decoy
Description: Phase: Any Phase Type: Passive This Unit is never Engaged. It cannot Engage Enemy Units, cannot be Engaged by Enemy Units and cannot perform a Charge Action. This Unit cannot be the target of an ability, unless stated otherwise. It can never Control or Contest Mission Markers.

Name: Lethal Hologram
Description: Phase: Any Phase Type: Passive All Weapons of Friendly Units targeting an Enemy Unit Within 4" of this Unit gain PRECISION (1).

Name: Surprise!
Description: Phase: Any Phase Type: Passive At the End of the Round, you can set a Friendly Nova Stealth Mode or Nova Assault Mode in Coherency with this Unit.

Name: Freedom Fighters
Description: Phase: Any Phase Type: Passive The Supply Value of all Friendly Units Within 8" of this Unit cannot be reduced below 1 for Contesting Mission Markers and completing objectives.

Name: Orders
Description: Phase: Movement Phase Type: Active Cost: X CP REPEATABLE. Select another Friendly Biological Unit Within 8", spend CP and apply one of the following effects: 1 CP: That Unit's first used weapon gains the CRITICAL HIT (2). 1 CP: That Unit ignores the Disengage penalty for the remainder of the Round. 2 CP: Remove the Activation Marker from that Unit.

Name: Concusive Shells
Description: Phase: Assault Phase Type: Reaction Cost: 1 CP When an Enemy declares a Charge against a Friendly Unit Within 8", that Enemy gains DEBUFF Speed (2).

Name: Stimpack (Marauders)
Description: Phase: Movement Phase Type: Active Cost: 1 CP This Unit suffers NON-LETHAL DAMAGE (2). This Unit gains BUFF Speed (3). Additionally, its Quad K12 and all Close Combat Weapons gain PRECISION (2).

Name: <color=#2596be>Kinetic Foam</color>
Description: Phase: Any Phase Type: Passive Upgrade ability Increase this Unit's Hit Points characteristic by 1.

Name: <color=#2596be>Veteran Of Tarsonis</color>
Description: Phase: Any Phase Type: Passive Upgrade ability While this Unit is Within 3" of a Mission Marker, its Armour characteristic is increased by 1.

Name: <color=#2596be>Laser Targeting Systems</color>
Description: Phase: Assault Phase Type: Passive Upgrade ability This Unit's Quad K12 weapon gains LONG RANGE (16").

Name: Stimpack
Description: Phase: Movement Phase Type: Active Cost: 1 CP This Unit suffers NON-LETHAL DAMAGE (2). This Unit gains BUFF Speed (3). Additionally, its C-14 Rifle and all Close Combat Weapons gain PRECISION (3).

Name: <color=#2596be>Grenades - Frag</color>
Description: Phase: Assault Phase Type: Passive Upgrade ability When this Unit makes a Ranged Attack with a C-14 Rifle and the target is Within 8", that weapon's S Dice is replaced by D6.

Name: <color=#2596be>Slugthrower</color>
Description: Phase: Assault Phase Type: Passive Upgrade ability When this Unit makes a Ranged Attack with a C-14 Rifle and the target is Within 8", that weapon gains ANTI-EVADE (1).

Name: <color=#2596be>Combat Shield</color>
Description: Phase: Movement Phase Type: Active Cost: 1 CP Upgrade ability This Unit is always eligible to make an Evade Roll against any Close Combat Attack targeting it and any Damage from an Enemy Special Ability.

Name: Life Support
Description: Phase: Any Phase Type: Reaction Cost: 1 CP Use when another Friendly Biological Unit suffers Damage Within 4". Reduce the Total Damage before allocation by 1 for each model in this Unit that is Within 4" of the damaged Unit.

Name: Restoration (Medics)
Description: Phase: Any Phase Type: Reaction Cost: 1 CP Use when a Friendly Unit Within 4" receives a DEBUFF. Remove all DEBUFFS from it.

Name: Medpack
Description: Phase: Movement Phase Type: Active Cost: 1 CP Select another Friendly Biological Unit Within 4". Resolve the HEAL (X) effect for the targeted Unit, where X is the number of models in this Unit that are Within 4" of the target Unit.

Name: Optical Flare
Description: Phase: Movement Phase Type: Active Cost: 2 CP Select one Enemy Unit Within 12". Until the End of the Round, apply DEBUFF Range (4) to that Unit's Ranged Weapons. That Unit cannot benefit from LONG RANGE.

Name: <color=#2596be>A-13 Flash Grenade Launcher</color>
Description: Phase: Any Phase Type: Passive Upgrade ability Increase the Optical Flare special ability's Range to 16".

Name: <color=#2596be>Optical Flare (Range 16")</color>
Description: Upgrade ability Phase: Movement Phase Type: Active Cost: 2 CP Select one Enemy Unit Within 16". Until the End of the Round, apply DEBUFF Range (4) to that Unit's Ranged Weapons. That Unit cannot benefit from LONG RANGE.

Name: <color=#2596be>Advanced Medic Facilities</color>
Description: Phase: Any Phase Type: Passive Upgrade ability This Unit's Supply Value counts as 0 when calculating the Supply Pool.
Supply: <color=#2596be>0</color> for calculating <u><link="rule_chapter_8_3_1">the Supply Pool</link></u> only

Name: <color=#2596be>Stabilizer Medpacks</color>
Description: Phase: Any Phase Type: Passive Upgrade ability When this Unit resolves a Life Support or Medpack ability, treat it as having 1 additional model Within Range for calculating that ability's effects.

Name: Battle Preparation
Description: Phase: Any Phase Type: Passive During Army Building, your army cannot include both the Nova Assault Mode Unit and the Nova Stealth Mode Unit.

Name: Ghost Visor
Description: Phase: Any Phase Type: Passive While Enemy Units are Within 6" of this Unit, they lose the HIDDEN Status.

Name: Phase Reactor Suit
Description: Phase: Assault Phase Type: Active Cost: 1 CP If Unengaged, resolve the PLACE (6) effect.

Name: Holo Decoy
Description: Phase: Movement Phase Type: Active Cost: 1 CP Resolve the SUMMON (Holo Decoy) effect. Then, Holo Decoy may immediately perform a Move action.

Name: Super Stimpack
Description: Phase: Movement Phase Type: Active Cost: 1 CP This Unit gains BUFF Speed (2). Additionally, all its Weapons gain PRECISION (2).

Name: Tactical Stealth Suit
Description: Phase: Any Phase Type: Passive After this Unit fully resolves an Action, it gains the HIDDEN Status.

Name: Head Shot
Description: Phase: Assault Phase Type: Reaction Cost: 1 CP Once Per Game. While this Unit is Unengaged and has the Stationary Status, when it makes a Ranged Attack with its C-20A Canister Rifle, treat that weapon's Damage characteristic as 3, and it gains CONCENTRATED FIRE (1).

Name: Operational Efficiency
Description: Phase: Assault Phase Type: Passive After this Unit fully resolves a Ranged Attack with its C-20A Canister Rifle, if the target Enemy Unit was Destroyed or its Current Supply Value was reduced, the active player may return one of their Exhausted non-Unique Tactical Cards to its Ready state.

Name: Gliding
Description: Phase: Any Phase Type: Passive This model has DISPLACEMENT.

Name: Point Defense Laser
Description: Phase: Any Phase Type: Passive When another Friendly Unit Within 4" is targeted by a Ranged Attack without the INSTANT keyword, remove up to 2 dice from the Attack Pool. Then remove this Unit from the battlefield.

Name: Detection
Description: Phase: Any Phase Type: Passive While Enemy Units are Within 6" of this Unit, they lose the HIDDEN Status.

Name: Anti-Armour Missile
Description: Phase: Movement Phase Type: Active Cost: 1 CP Select one Enemy Unit Within 12". Apply DEBUFF Armour (1).

Name: Deploy Auto-Turret
Description: Phase: Movement Phase Type: Active Cost: 1 CP Set a Friendly Auto-Turret Unit Within 6", and not Within the Engagement Range of any Enemy Unit.

Name: <color=#2596be>Corvid Reactor</color>
Description: Phase: Any Phase Type: Passive Upgrade ability This Unit may resolve its first Special Ability with the CP cost reduced by 1 if it targets the closest Enemy Unit.

Name: <color=#2596be>Explosive Shrapnel Shells</color>
Description: Phase: Assault Phase Type: Passive Upgrade ability The Gauss Cannon of the Auto-Turret set by this Unit gains Surge Type: Light and S-Dice: D3+1.

Name: <color=#2596be>Internal Tech Module</color>
Description: Phase: Movement Phase Type: Passive Upgrade ability When this Unit is nominated to deploy from Reserves, it may Deploy from any table edge that is not a player's Entry Edge. This Unit cannot be set Within 8" of any Enemy model.

Name: <color=#2596be>Seeker Missile</color>
Description: Phase: Movement Phase Type: Active Cost: 1 CP Upgrade ability Select one Enemy Unit Within 12". At the End of the Assault Phase, if that Enemy Unit has the Stationary Status or it is Within 8'' of this Unit, it suffers HITS 4 (2). If that Unit is Engaged, it is eligible to make an Evade Roll against these hits.

Name: Grenades - Frag
Description: Phase: Assault Phase Type: Passive When this Unit makes a Ranged Attack with a C-14 Rifle and the target is Within 8", that weapon's S Dice is replaced by D6.

Name: Slugthrower
Description: Phase: Assault Phase Type: Passive When this Unit makes a Ranged Attack with a C-14 Rifle and the target is Within 8", that weapon gains ANTI-EVADE (1).

Name: Raiders Roll!
Description: Phase: Movement Phase Type: Passive When this Unit is nominated to deploy from Reserves, it may resolve its Stimpack ability with the CP cost reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 0).

Name: Rapid Reinforcements
Description: Phase: Movement Phase Type: Passive When this Unit is nominated to deploy from Reserves, it may resolve the PLACE (10) effect from another Friendly Unit. No model may be set Within 8" of any Enemy model. This Unit's Activation ends.

Name: Have A Nice Day
Description: Phase: Assault Phase Type: Passive At the End of the Assault Phase, target each Unit Within 3" of this Unit (including Units with the Structure ability) suffers HITS 5 (1). If an affected Unit has the Structure ability, that Unit suffers an additional HITS 5 (1).

Name: Heavy Plating
Description: Phase: Any Phase Type: Passive When this Unit resolves an Armour Roll, it gains TOUGH (1), provided it does not currently have the SIEGE MODE Status.

Name: Large
Description: Phase: Any Phase Type: Passive When this Unit's Leading Model moves, it cannot pass through physical gaps smaller than 3" wide, regardless of its size. If the Leading Model's path of travel passes through, or any model in this Unit ends its movement on a Size 0 or Size 1 Impassible Terrain piece (excluding Tokens) during any movement action, that terrain piece is immediately removed from the game.

Name: Aftershock Rounds
Description: Phase: Assault Phase Type: Passive When this Unit has the SIEGE MODE Status, its Damage characteristic is treated as equal to the Size characteristic of the current target Unit (to a minimum of 1).

Name: Point Blank
Description: Phase: Assault Phase Type: Passive While this Unit has the SIEGE MODE Status, it cannot target Enemy Units it is Engaged with.

Name: <color=#2596be>Shaped Blast</color>
Description: Phase: Assault Phase Type: Reaction Cost: 0 CP Upgrade ability Once per Game. When this Unit declares a Ranged Attack action. If this Unit has SIEGE MODE Status, its weapon gains PINPOINT and LOCKED IN (4).

Name: <color=#2596be>Smart Shells</color>
Description: Phase: Assault Phase Type: Reaction Cost: 0 CP Upgrade ability Once per Game. When this Unit declares a Ranged Attack action. If this Unit has SIEGE MODE Status, its weapon gains INDIRECT FIRE and LONG RANGE (24).

Name: <color=#2596be>Coordinated Strike</color>
Description: Phase: Movement Phase Type: Active Cost: 0 CP Upgrade ability Target a Friendly Non-Engaged Unit on the battlefield (Line of Sight is not required). When this Unit resolves a Ranged Attack using the Shock Cannon weapon profile this Round, it may choose to ignore the weapon's standard Range characteristic. If it does, it may target an Enemy Unit that is Within 8" of, and Visible to, a model of the selected Friendly Unit, treating that model as the acting model.

Name: <color=#2596be>Mode Transformation</color>
Description: Phase: Movement Phase Type: Active Cost: 1 CP Upgrade ability The active Unit gains or loses the SIEGE MODE Status. While this Unit has the SIEGE MODE Status, its Size characteristic is treated as if it was 3.

Name: Spec Ops Armour
Description: Phase: Any Phase Type: Active Cost: 1 CP This Unit gains the HIDDEN Status until it performs another action.

Description: Phase: Assault Phase Type: Passive This Unit's first Attack in the game with its Quad K12 gains PIERCE Armoured (3).
